chunks.title: FinDev Canada (FinDev Canada) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: FinDev Canada is a Bilateral DFI headquartered in Canada. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Co-launched '10by30' ($10B emerging market climate finance collaboration) at COP31 on Nov 13. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Co-delivering $10B '10by30' via Climate Mobilization Strategy ($2.72B committed portfolio as of June 2026; 47% climate finance). Source verification: https://africa.businessinsider.com/local/markets/britain-canada-and-norway-combine-forces-for-dollar10-billion-climate-push-as-their/98mpx59.

chunks.title: FinDev Canada Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: FinDev Canada provides the following climate financing instruments: Senior/Subordinated Debt, Equity, Blended Finance, Guarantee, Technical Assistance. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 5,000,000 to USD 100,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Project SPV, Large Corporate, Financial Intermediary, Growth-Stage Private Enterprise.

chunks.title: FinDev Canada Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by FinDev Canada: Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, Electrification & Grid, Clean Transport, Sustainable Agriculture & Water, Industrial Decarbonization. Target geographic focus includes: Africa, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Caribbean. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: FinDev Canada Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete FinDev Canada's application form: 2X Challenge gender-lens & market development impact; 10by30 harmonized GHG & climate impact reporting; IFC Performance Standards & E&S management system; Geographic mandate (Africa, Asia-Pacific, LAC). Explicit exclusion rules: Coal, upstream oil & gas, non-mandate high-income countries. Official application portal: https://www.findevcanada.ca/en/what-we-do/how-we-invest.

chunks.title: FinDev Canada Form Template: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
chunks.text: FinDev Canada uses the 'Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form' workflow governed by IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC). Typical review timeline is 4–12 weeks (Screening -> Due Diligence -> Credit Committee). Form sections required: 1. Sponsor Profile, 2. Transaction Structure, 3. Climate & Impact, 4. Financial Due Diligence, 5. Risk Assessment, 6. Executive Summary.
